doc_title: CONSENT TO RECTIFY THE REGISTER BY A COMPANY
doc_title_official: CONSENT TO RECTIFY THE REGISTER BY A COMPANY
when_used: A company affected by an intended rectification of the register consents to it under its common seal, so that the Registrar may rectify. The Ministry prints this form for a company only, so the party giving consent is always a body corporate and the form is drawn with its registration number and its common seal.

body_text.text: The above named being the affected party hereby acknowledges and declares that :-
It has full knowledge of the intended rectification; and
It has understood the nature and effect of this Consent;
AND the Company HEREBY CONSENTS to the rectification of the register.
IN WITNESS the Company has signed this Consent as a deed.

custom_fields.name: nature_of_rectification
custom_fields.label: Nature of the rectification consented to
custom_fields.prompt: What is to be rectified in the register, set out as the entry to be corrected and the correction sought
